messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Jari, MW-412 lost alignment in last night's storm. Signal way down. Should I bring a new radio?

messages.author: Jari Jänne
messages.text: No. Check the mount bolts first. Storm usually just loosens the mount

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Two bolts loose on the pole mount, dish turned a bit

messages.author: Jari Jänne
messages.text: Tighten them and re-align. Radio is fine

messages.author: Jari Jänne
messages.text: Good. Never seen the radio die from wind on these
